The answer is only partly covered. The mechanism is clear, but I could not find the change or ticket that added it.

**How the value is supplied at assembly time:** the `openmrs assemble` command takes `--application-version`. The CLI option is declared at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:345-350` and passed through as `applicationVersion` at line 368. `assemble.ts` writes it as the top-level `version` of `routes.registry.json` at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.ts:393-399`. Empty, null, or missing values are omitted. The README documents the flag at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:166`.

**How the shell exposes it:** at startup, `runShell` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts:104-124` reads `initialRouteMap.version` and defines `window.applicationVersion`. The value `prerelease` is special-cased: it becomes a "Local" or "Prerelease" label depending on `window.spaVersion` (line 114).

**Where it is shown by default:** the sign-in page renders it under the login form at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login/login.component.tsx:258`, only when the value is truthy. The primary navigation bar also shows it, at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/components/navbar/navbar.component.tsx:65`.

**When nobody sets it:** `window.applicationVersion` is defined as `undefined`, so nothing is rendered on the sign-in page. The tests confirm that an omitted, empty, or null value leaves the registry without a version (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.test.ts:462-500`).

**Change and ticket:** not found. The Falkon tools I had (grep, glob, read_file, list_tree, list_repos, symbol lookups) do not expose commit history, and a search for ticket keys (`O3-`, `TRUNK-`) in the tooling and login-app paths returned nothing. Identifying the commit and ticket needs commit history, e.g. `git log -S "application-version"` on `openmrs-esm-core`, or the `list_commits` tool if it is available to you.
